metadata.title: Bernstein theorem for $3$-dimensional anisotropic minimal graphs with free boundary
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we continue our recent study on anisotropic minimal surface equation with free boundary condition in Wang-Wei-Xia-Zhang (Arch Ration Mech Anal 250:42, 2026). The first main result solves the corresponding mixed boundary value problem. As an application, we prove the following Bernstein-type theorem: any anisotropic minimal graph over $\mathbb{R}^3_+$ with free boundary must be flat. These extend the classical results of Simon (Indiana Univ Math J 25:821--855, 1976; Math Z 154:265--273, 1977) to an appropriate free boundary setting.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 自由边界 Bernstein 定理
analysis.workSummary: 作者解决一类各向异性极小曲面方程的混合边值问题，并据此证明 R³ 正半空间上带自由边界的各向异性极小图必平坦。
techniques: 各向异性极小曲面方程
analysis.breakthrough: 将经典各向异性整图刚性推进到适当自由边界环境。
analysis.limitations: 各向异性积分被积函数条件及边界正则假设在摘要中未列全，须回查主定理。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 与几何 PDE、自由边界和整体刚性直接相关，边值技术可能可复用。
